questions.text: What is the role of the ALU?

answer.text: It performs arithmetic operations and logical comparisons.

questions.text: State the function of the control unit.

answer.text: It coordinates the execution of instructions and controls data flow.

questions.text: What does the program counter contain?

answer.text: The address of the next instruction to fetch.
